map.汽蒸是印花与染色固色的关键工序，温度、湿度、时间三者共同决定固色效果。本工具按工: Steaming is the key step for fixing colour in printing and dyeing, and temperature, humidity and time together determine the fixation effect. This tool assesses whether steaming conditions meet the standard by process type, helping control steaming quality.
